data.summary: Hausverwaltung Beispieldach und Partner informs tenant Bastian Musterquell that a partial rent shortfall for November 2026 and an unpaid operating cost back payment for 2025 are outstanding, totalling 526.42 EUR, and asks for payment by 7 December 2026.
data.explanation: Your property management company says part of November's rent and last year's operating-cost settlement are still unpaid, totaling 526.42 EUR. They ask you to transfer this amount by 7 December 2026, and mention that an installment plan is possible if you are in temporary difficulty. If the arrears remain unpaid, landlords can usually proceed to further reminders or legal steps, so it is best to act before the deadline.

items.action: Transfer the total outstanding amount of 526.42 EUR to the landlord's account by the deadline stated in the letter, or contact them about an installment plan if you can't pay in full.
